'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Obeid]]
***[[Sudanese Armed Forces]] capture [[El Obeid]], pushing the [[Rapid Support Forces]] out of the city, although skirmishes continue on the outskirts of the city. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/battles-continue-in-sudan-at-least-48-million-people-fled-their-homes (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Deir ez-Zor clashes (2023)]]
***[[Arab]] [[tribe]]smen briefly take control of two villages in [[Aleppo Governorate]] in order to support fellow tribesmen fighting the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] in northeast [[Syria]], as the battle enters its third day with at least 45 people killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/1/fighting-between-arab-tribes-and-sdf-spreads-to-northwest-syria (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis (2021–present)|Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis]]
***[[Armenia]] says that [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] by [[Military of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani forces]] in the town of [[Sotk]] killed four of [[Armenian Ground Forces|its soldiers]] and injured another by striking its positions across the border using [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/two-armenian-soldiers-killed-azerbaijani-shelling-defence-ministry-2023-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is killed and several others are injured, a building is destroyed and ambulances are obstructed and shot at, during a raid by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Aqabah]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/1/palestinian-farmer-killed-in-gunfight-after-israeli-raid-on-west-bank-town (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**Gunmen kill nine people including seven in a [[mosque]] in [[Ikara]] [[Local government areas of Nigeria|Local Government Area]] in [[Nigeria]]'s [[Kaduna State]] as [[worship]]pers gathered for [[prayer]]. Two other injured people were taken to hospital for treatment. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-seven-worshippers-nigerias-northern-kaduna-state-2023-09-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/619223-nine-people-killed-in-kaduna-mosque-attack.html (Premium Times)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**Five [[Polisario Front]] militants, including a leader, are killed during an [[airstrike]] by [[Morocco]] near [[Tindouf]]. The [[President of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic|Sahrawi presidency]] declares three days of [[mourning]].  [https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/4523701-five-members-polisario-front-killed-moroccan-raid (Asharq Al-Awsat)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022–2023 food crises]]
**The [[Philippines]] imposes [[price ceiling]]s on [[Rice production in the Philippines|rice]] in order to counter increasing costs and alleged [[market manipulation]], setting the maximum prices for regular-milled and well-milled rice, at {{Philippine peso|41|link=yes}} ([[United States dollar|US$]]0.72) and {{Philippine peso|45}} ($0.80) per kilogram, respectively. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-curbs-rice-prices-inflation-worry-mounts-2023-09-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Hong Kong]] raises its [[Hong Kong tropical cyclone warning signals|typhoon warning signal]] to level 10, the highest level, as [[Typhoon Saola (2023)|Super Typhoon Saola]] approaches. Over 880,000 people in the Chinese provinces of [[Fujian]] and [[Guangdong]] have been evacuated. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230901-super-typhoon-saola-sweeps-towards-southern-china-megacities (AFP via France 24)]
*Eighteen people are killed and 13 are injured after two [[minibus]]es carrying mostly [[Iran|Iranian]] [[Shia Islam|Shia]] pilgrims collide between [[Dujail]] and [[Samarra]] in [[Saladin Governorate]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/iran-pilgrims-among-16-dead-in-iraq-crash-state-media-ed3f24e0# (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*Six people are killed when a train collides with a minibus at a [[railroad crossing]] in [[San Pedro de la Paz]], [[Bío-Bío Region]], [[Chile]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230902/417bffc1f14a4d0c8f8437fd23d13197/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people are killed when an outdoor [[gondola lift|lift cable]] snaps and falls into a ravine at a resort in [[Ubud]], [[Bali]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2023/09/01/five-resort-workers-die-in-bali-lift-accident (DPA via ''The Star'')]
*Two people are killed and at least 12 others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a metal factory in [[Cabreúva]], [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. Two helicopters and several [[fire department]] tanker units are dispatched to the scene of the explosion, which generated a strong fire. [https://english.news.cn/20230902/9fca4d24c16446ada928780bf92e23e4/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Morocco relations]]
**Two Moroccan-French [[tourism in Morocco|tourists]] are shot dead and another is injured by the [[Algerian National Navy]] after being lost on a [[jet ski]] near [[Saïdia]] and accidentally crossing the [[Algeria–Morocco border|border]] into [[Algeria]]n waters. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-66678886.amp (BBC)]
*[[Foreign relations of the Holy See]], [[Foreign relations of Mongolia]]
**[[Pope Francis]] arrives in [[Mongolia]], marking the first [[papal visit]] to the country, which has a small [[Catholic Church in Mongolia|Catholic]] population. [https://www.ncronline.org/vatican/vatican-news/pope-francis-becomes-first-pontiff-visit-mongolia-neighboring-russia-china (''NCR'')]
*[[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[Roscosmos]] head [[Yury Borisov]] announces that the [[RS-28 Sarmat]] [[Intercontinental ballistic missile|ICBM]] has been deployed for combat duty. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/09/01/russia-deploys-sarmat-icbm-for-combat-duty-a82333 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Eighteen people are killed during a [[shootout]] between robbers and police in [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]]. The suspects are suspected to have been planning a cash truck heist, also called a [[Cash-in-transit|cash-in-transit heist]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/1/south-african-police-say-18-suspected-robbers-killed-in-shootout (Al Jazeera)]
*Twenty-five people are arrested after a [[riot]] at a [[kok-boru]] event in [[Osh Region]], [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/09/01/sports/kyrgyzstan-kok-boru-goat.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Singaporean presidential election]]
**Former [[Senior Minister of Singapore|senior minister]] [[Tharman Shanmugaratnam]] is elected as the 9th president of [[Singapore]] with over 70% of the valid votes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/former-ruling-party-member-wins-singapore-presidential-race-elections-department-2023-09-01/ (Reuters)]
